result:
The decisive error was MovieProp_Expert's claim at Step 2 that the parachute was white. In the film, Bond and Pussy Galore hide under an orange and white parachute. The answer should have been "orange, white". This claim was incomplete, and FilmCritic_Expert later confirmed it without really checking. JamesBondFilms_Expert's Step 1 summary was also wrong, since it said they parachuted out of the plane. But the colour was the point of the question, and MovieProp_Expert was the one asked for it.
